issues.description: Lecture constructor visibility is unspecified in the problem statement/UML, but the reference solution defines the constructor without an access modifier (package-private). If tests or students expect to instantiate Lecture from outside the package (as typical for such exercises), a non-public constructor can prevent instantiation and is confusing given the generic instruction to "create a constructor".
issues.suggestedFix: Make the constructor explicitly public in the intended reference API (and, if applicable, reflect this in the UML/problem statement), e.g., `public Lecture(String lectureName, int numberOfInscribedStudents, int numberOfGuestStudents, int numberOfLecturers, int numberOfTutors) { ... }`.
